newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila probes possible stock market manipulation.
newsitem.headline: Manila probes possible stock market manipulation.

text.p: Authorities are investigating recent major transactions on the Philippine Stock Exchange to determine whether there has been any price manipulation, Finance Secretary Roberto de Ocampo said on Thursday.

"The Securities and Exchange Commission and the Philippine Stock Exchange are analysing the volume, direction and source of the major transactions to see whether this is a game being played by a handful," he told a news conference.
De Ocampo said "corrective actions" would be imposed on traders if they were found to have manipulated the fall in the share prices. He did not elaborate.
The stock market index has slumped almost 10 percent this month on persistent speculation of an imminent property and banking crisis.

Two companies -- Megaworld Properties & Holdings Inc and its subsidiary Empire East Land Holdings Inc -- have been hardest hit forcing both the firms and government officials to deny they were facing financial ruin.
De Ocampo said he was confident the rumours would not shake investor confidence.
"These, for now, are just aberrations, as long as we maintain our sound economic fundamentals," he said.
But he urged the Philippine Stock Exchange to ensure there were enough safeguards to prevent price manipulation and insider trading.
Though insider trading is against the law there has been no successful conviction so far.
